svg.title: Where the model is allowed to act
svg.desc: A sequence diagram. In the deterministic zone the coach taps a batter, recommendations.js weights contacts and renders fielder moves instantly with no network. Only afterwards, optionally, does a serverless function pass the finished recommendation to gpt-4o-mini for phrasing.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where the model is allowed to act

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rules engine decides. The model is confined to phrasing a decision already made.
